{{Top|leg}}
'''Twin-pod paracapsules''' were orbit-to-surface entry vehicles used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Ion Storm]]'' deployed [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] and single-person [[Waveskimmer/Legends|waveskimmers]] via twin-pod paracapsules during an orbital insertion on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
